mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort_order, visible, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_menu WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort_order, visible, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_menu WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_menu (parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort_order, visible, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, perms = #{perms}, icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
